findings.detail: The source schedule includes 2025 Other income lines of 9,953 and 35 (thousand), which appear absent from the extracted income identity and explain most of the 10.065 million residual.
The non-controlled/affiliated Other income line of 35 (thousand) is part of the 2025 investment income subtotal and should be included in the income identity components.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate income-identity flag. Raw source table 7 shows 2025 Total investment income of 657,565 thousand. The visible 2025 investment-income components foot to that total: 619,613 + 19,306 + 5,565 + 9,953 + 677 + 1,042 + 200 + 35 + 1,174 = 657,565. The flagged residual is 10,065,000, implying an extracted observed identity value of 647,500,000 versus the schedule-total anchor of 657,565,000. Because the filer schedule itself balances, the blocker reflects an extraction/classification gap in the platform data, not a source arithmetic problem. The two Other income rows explain 9,988,000 of the residual; the remaining 77,000 is not localized from the available row structure, so localization is conservative.
